_note: All boxes are fractions of the image (x, y = top-left, w, h). basket: the visible basket body (basket-back.png's opaque bbox, about 0.906 x 0.768 of the 512 sprite); its bottom edge is the ground line, and the yarn holder stands to its right on the same line. decor boxes: where each decor sprite (items/decor-<id>.png) is drawn; each box matches its sprite's aspect, so draw it to fill the box. window: the window glass, for snow.
